findings.title: runners/orchid-pump fires the stale-root gate 60 lines and two repo writes after its authorization decision
the derived early-exit scan and the INV-15 spec sentence exclude tests/, where the invariant gates themselves still carry fail-open `| grep -q ... && fail`
section 2's helpers-loaded scan covers only tests/inv/test_*.sh, not the PROOF_ENROLLED_FILES half of the same enrolment rule
PQ_EARLY_EXIT matches only single-dash `-q`; `grep --quiet` and a `|`-terminated line with grep on the next are invisible to the scan
